title: Michigan swamp gas case

tellings.quote: Michigan swamp gas. Uh you also see large disc-like objects.

plain: In a famous Michigan case, sightings were officially put down to swamp gas, glowing gas from marshes, though large disc-shaped objects were also described. The analyst Marik von Rennenkampff brings it up while debating a UFO skeptic on Michels' show, naming it in passing with no source. He cites it as an example of an official explanation that, to him, does not fit what was seen.
